numerical_results.coefficient_instrumentation: Private overlay instruments the CURRENT Go coefficient block and compares starts and every signed Q22 integer against independent tables:24→77 has77 rows/432 entries;1397→1285 has1285 rows/8371 entries. All exactly equal.
numerical_results.covered: Gray/NRGBA mode and fresh output; source subimage origin/stride/padding and immutability; identity before premultiplication/hiddenRGB; skipped unchanged axes; ordinary H→V and tall V→H; finite support/boundary normalization/signed Q22 rounding; byte clipping after each axis; rounded MULDIV255 premultiplication; floor unpremultiplication, with final alpha0/255 retaining already-filtered RGB.

numerical_results.mutation_limit: The clipping mutant removes per-pass saturation before byte conversion; a separate full floating/fused implementation was not built.
